records.sql: SELECT p.sub_category, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS total_profit, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit)/SUM(oi.sales)*100, 2) AS profit_margin_pct FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.sales IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.sub_category ORDER BY SUM(oi.profit)/SUM(oi.sales) DESC LIMIT 3

records.question: 哪个商品子类的利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最低?
records.chart_reading: 17 项中最高是 Phones(75,119.47),其次 Copiers(52,315.19),最低 Supplies(-89.85)。按 total_sales 计,最高是 Phones(417,939.31)。其中有 1 项为负值,如实画出。
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS total_profit,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.profit) / SUM(oi.sales), 4) AS profit_margin
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE oi.sales IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.sub_category
ORDER BY profit_margin ASC

records.question: Corporate 客户在 2014 年下了多少张订单,平均每张订单金额是多少?

SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_cnt, AVG(order_sales) AS avg_order_sales
FROM (
  SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.sales) AS order_sales
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE c.segment = 'Corporate' AND o.order_date >= '2014-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2015-01-01'
  GROUP BY o.order_id
)

records.question: 所有明细的销售额中位数是多少?
records.sql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sales) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS n
  FROM order_items WHERE sales IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(sales) AS median_sales, MAX(n) AS cnt FROM s
WHERE rn IN ((n + 1) / 2, (n + 2) / 2)

records.question: First Class 配送方式的平均运费是多少?

SELECT COUNT(*) AS item_rows,
       ROUND(AVG(oi.shipping_cost), 4) AS avg_ship_item,
       (SELECT ROUND(AVG(s), 4)
          FROM (SELECT SUM(oi2.shipping_cost) AS s
                  FROM order_items oi2
                  JOIN orders o2 ON o2.order_id = oi2.order_id
                 WHERE o2.ship_mode = 'First Class'
                 GROUP BY oi2.order_id)) AS avg_ship_order
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.ship_mode = 'First Class';
